project.title: ComfyUI Image Viewer
project.summary: A local ComfyUI image library with searchable metadata, focused review, reliable live updates, and optional workflow controls.

preview.description: Comfy Viewer pairs a searchable image grid with optional workflow settings and run controls.

blocks.body:
## Review a growing collection of generated images

ComfyUI can produce many iterations of an idea, but an output folder provides little help with comparing results or finding a useful generation again. I built Comfy Viewer as a local review interface for that collection.

The library combines cached image previews with searchable metadata. A focused viewer provides nearby-image navigation, quicksave, flags, and ratings. These review decisions stay associated with the image while the original output remains available.

blocks.description: The focused viewer keeps save, flag, rating, and navigation controls beside the selected image.

blocks.body:
## Keep live updates from interrupting review

File watching and server notifications bring completed generations into the library. Stable ordering and cursor-based paging let a large collection grow while the viewer keeps its place. Following the newest image receives fresh results; browsing an older image preserves that selection.

The full-resolution image downloads and decodes before replacing the display. Interrupted downloads retry, and superseded requests cannot replace a newer selection. That keeps the image, metadata, and review actions attached to the same result.

## Match the cost of browsing to the view

The library requests thumbnail resolutions that match its tile-size preset. Smaller tiles can use smaller WebP previews, while larger tiles retain additional detail. Separate cache entries make switching sizes inexpensive.

The browser loads a bounded portion of the collection and the focused viewer requests nearby images. These choices keep the interface useful as the output library accumulates.

## Bring generation controls into the same workspace

With ComfyUI Conduit connected, the viewer can discover configured workflows, display their typed inputs, submit runs, and show generation status. Gallery browsing and focused review retain their own application boundary.

The installable Python package owns configuration, file access, indexing, and browser delivery. Metadata hooks and the optional workflow gateway extend that core through explicit interfaces.
